About

My design sense comes from a sketchbook, not a software tutorial — years of watercolor and acrylic painting taught me color theory and composition before I ever opened Figma. Over the past year I've been turning that instinct toward screens: building small web pages, laying out posters for college events, and learning the basics of front-end code alongside it. I want a design team that treats visuals and usability as one problem, not two.
